Below, two smaller whole-body action studies of that same woman: calmly indicating where to work with an empty hand, and bending slightly to look down at an unseen well during her solitary night visit. No well or other characters on this identity sheet. Keep face, hair, garment and palette constant, hands readable and feet visible. Facial contours simple, neither photorealistic nor a toy doll.
